body.text: New York now requires gun owners to lock up firearms that are not under their immediate control, and has expanded checks on ammunition buyers.

Governor Hochul signed Francesco's Law Wednesday evening: firearms must be secured with a locked container, trigger lock or other device when not under the owner's immediate control, with escalating penalties when a minor or prohibited person is likely to gain access. Effective date and statute text not yet read.
